cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you help clear out the committee cupboard? I've crossed off names just as you did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, but my crosses mark who missed the meeting. They don't mean throw out their files.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, attendance first. Let's clear out the members who never turn up, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to sort paper. My name's crossed out too; I was in hospital.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then help me separate an absence from an excuse. We'll keep your file and start asking the others where they were.

reason: Create a specific misunderstood copied action which determines how A pursues this Drive, preserving useful seed causality and giving B a concrete concern that changes the ending.
